notes: Phase 1 local proposal only. All 43 synthetic images visually inspected. No uploads or incident submissions.
Only images[].event is a Common Event Model payload. Wrapper fields document evidence and manual review.
Existing event IDs, Blob paths, evidence URIs and storage configuration are preserved by exact local_path mapping.
Visible camera IDs take precedence over demo assignments. All 43 images display readable camera IDs.
Visible timestamp strings are transcribed without timezone inference. Actual capture times cannot be established.
Event timestamps are separately simulated UTC times starting 2026-09-27T00:00:00Z, one minute apart in manifest order.
Site IDs and severity are demo assignments. Confidence is a simulated incident-level test value of 0.95, not a measured model output.
Visible object detection scores, where recorded, remain image annotations; they are not incident-level confidence.
People Count headlines are transcribed synthetic labels, not independently measured or verified headcounts.
All intrusion images display CAM-01, but location labels vary. This source/location ambiguity remains unresolved.
Validation verifies structure, file hashes and metadata consistency; it does not independently perform OCR or establish capture authenticity.
